GetWorld
functions.docs:
Get the UWorld associated with this Capture Protocol. This is not valid until
Setup has been called with a valid Slate viewport. Will return nullptr when
the protocol has been created but the game world is not running (ie: in UI).

functions.name: PreTick
functions.docs: Called on the main thread before the movie capture itself is updated to reset per-frame state

functions.docs: Start warming up this capture protocol - called any time the process enters a warming-up state

Called when this protocol should start capturing

BeginFinalize
functions.docs: Called when we have finished capturing and we should start finalizing the capture

functions.name: HasFinishedProcessing
functions.docs:
Check whether this protocol has any processing left to do, or whether it should be finalized.
Only called when the capture has been asked to end.

functions.name: Finalize
functions.docs: Called when this protocol should tear down and finalize all its processing. Only called if HasFinishedProcessing is true.
